company.name: Anrok
company.shortDescription: Anrok is a global sales tax solution platform that automates sales tax compliance for modern commerce.
company.description: Anrok provides a software platform for global sales tax and VAT compliance. It handles integration with billing, payment, and HR systems to monitor tax exposure, validate VAT IDs, automate sales tax calculations, manage registrations, and coordinate filing and remittance processes. The company supports real-time tax collection, tracking of physical and economic nexus and consolidated compliance reporting across jurisdictions. It offers no-code and API‐based connections to finance stacks, facilitating audit-ready transaction logs and jurisdictional coverage for digital services and goods.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that manages sales tax and VAT compliance from nexus monitoring and registration through calculation, filing, remittance, reconciliation, and audit reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Anrok Global Sales Tax Compliance Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered tax assistant built into Anrok that answers sales tax questions using a customer’s account data and Anrok’s tax knowledge base, with visible reasoning steps.
